clips.title: The story
paras: East of Camp Taurajo, Takar the Seer keeps a lone camp in the Barrens. Though surrounded by Horde lands, he remains loyal to the Alliance and shares occult knowledge with certain travelers.

Takar the Seer lives alone beneath a simple tent east of Camp Taurajo. Tauren braves and orc patrols watch the surrounding Barrens, yet leave his remote clearing undisturbed. He distrusts curious Horde visitors but rarely starts a fight, keeping watch on the horizon and to himself. His camp lies far from Stormwind's politics.

Takar the Seer shares his knowledge with a few visitors from beyond his camp. Alliance warlocks who come from the Eastern Kingdoms seek his cryptic counsel when they try to bind dangerous beings from beyond this world. His understanding of hidden forces and the craft of souls draws these practitioners to his remote, perilous camp.
